description: This file defines Sass functions and mixins related to responsive breakpoints for media queries in a CSS framework, including functions for calculating next, min, max breakpoints, and mixins for applying styles at specific viewport widths.

methods.name: breakpoint-next
methods.description: Returns the next breakpoint name after the given one from the list of breakpoint names.

methods.name: breakpoint-min
methods.description: Returns the minimum width for a given breakpoint name from the grid breakpoints map.

methods.name: breakpoint-max
methods.description: Calculates and returns the maximum width for a given breakpoint name, adjusted for fractional pixel issues.

methods.name: breakpoint-infix
methods.description: Provides a string suffix for breakpoint-based utilities, empty for the smallest breakpoint.

methods.name: media-breakpoint-up
methods.description: Mixin that applies styles for viewports wider than or equal to a given breakpoint.

methods.name: media-breakpoint-down
methods.description: Mixin that applies styles for viewports less than or equal to a given breakpoint.

methods.name: media-breakpoint-between
methods.description: Mixin to apply styles between two breakpoints.

methods.name: media-breakpoint-only
methods.description: Mixin to apply styles only within a specific breakpoint range.
